tools/README.md.text: A refusal before the start: if a condition is not met, `run` throws an error (`E_EXECUTOR`, `E_REAL_RUNS_OFF`, `E_NO_BUDGET`, `E_WORK_DIR`, `E_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED`, `E_SCENARIO`) before any action — no process is created, the journal does not change. The conditions are checked by `run` itself, so they cannot be bypassed by a direct call. The answer of the executor is checked against the schema once more on our side: an answer outside the schema is the result `invalid_output` («Ответ исполнителя не соответствует схеме», the answer of the executor does not match the schema), the result is not accepted. From the answer only the fields of the schema are taken (`summary`, `files`, `memory`): the agent's text changes neither the executor, nor the ceiling, nor the role, nor the statuses.

The output is one JSON line in stdout. Exit codes: 0 — success; 1 — a refusal on the merits (for example, `E_REAL_RUNS_OFF`, `E_NO_BUDGET`, `E_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED`, `E_EXECUTOR_NOT_FOUND`, `E_TASK_FAILED: Задача не получилась: <причина>` (the task failed: <reason>), `E_TASK_CANCELLED`, `E_TASK_STATE`, `E_PROJECT_STATE`, `E_SCENARIO`, `E_DISK`, `E_PROJECT_BUSY`); 2 — wrong arguments or settings (`E_USAGE`, `E_CONFIG`); 3 — an internal error (`E_INTERNAL`). On an error stdout is empty, stderr has one line `<CODE>: <message>` without a stack trace; the events written before the refusal stay in the journal — this is the truth about the attempts.
